headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | Python, PostgreSQL & React
summary: Backend and Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4 years of professional experience developing web applications and APIs. Solid background in Python (Django, FastAPI) and relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL. Experienced in working within Agile/Scrum teams, maintaining CI/CD workflows, and contributing to React-based frontend interfaces.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Develop and maintain backend services in Python (FastAPI and Django) connected to PostgreSQL databases for B2B client portals.
Optimized slow-running SQL queries and added appropriate indexing in PostgreSQL, reducing average API response times by 20%.
Build and update responsive user interface components using React and TypeScript in collaboration with the product design team.
Configure and maintain automated testing and deployment pipelines using GitLab CI/CD.
Participate actively in bi-weekly Agile/Scrum sprints, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and peer code reviews.

experience.title: Junior Backend & Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Contributed to the development of internal management web applications using Python and MySQL.
Implemented RESTful endpoints for inventory tracking and reporting modules, serving over 50 daily business users.
Wrote unit and integration tests using pytest, increasing backend test coverage from 45% to 68%.
Assisted in frontend bug fixing and feature implementation using JavaScript and React.
